feature: Term work evidence private file upload, MySQL path persistence and approver preview

storage.removed_files: logical removal with retained private bytes and metadata

security_checks: Only Admin/Superadmin in document Branch uploads on draft/returned status.
Approvers preview actual private files through authenticated Branch-scoped GET with inline/download and PDF range support.
Pending/rejected/approved files cannot be added or removed. Return permits amendments while preserving past files.
Posted path/uploader/evidence/scan/Finance/APM/payment metadata cannot bypass server state.
Invalid type/size, revision conflict, replay and SQL failure leave no duplicate or orphan new files.
limits: Attachments are optional; existing approval requirements unchanged.
Individual uploads commit independently when multiple files are selected.
No HEIC/Office conversion, OCR, antivirus or automated history retention cleanup.
Native browser PDF/image rendering not manually tested after login; headers/bytes/range/component rendering verified automatically.
MySQL full-flow wet-signature scan is synthetic metadata; work evidence upload used real synthetic PDF bytes in the isolated filesystem.
